purpose: Test the sealed V55 common amplitude diagnosis with one matched objective augmentation: retain the complete V54 bounded NLL and four fixed proper Brier terms, add a proper physical-moment-weighted survival Brier grid from q99.999 to the immutable global train maximum, and require absolute train high-backbone moment calibration before any development sampling.

single_changed_factor.base_objective: the complete V54 objective: unchanged equal-source bounded negative log likelihood plus 0.1 times the unchanged mean of four q(1-q)-normalized fixed-threshold Brier scores
single_changed_factor.added_term: 0.1 times one predeclared physical-moment-weighted upper survival-grid Brier score

upper_survival_grid.lower_edge: the immutable V54 common q99.999 threshold common_log10rho_thresholds[3]
upper_survival_grid.upper_edge: the exact maximum of the three immutable domain maximum_log10rho values in the V54 threshold artifact
upper_survival_grid.threshold_rule: for j=1,...,16 use lower_edge + j*(upper_edge-lower_edge)/16 in IEEE float64; the final threshold equals the immutable global train maximum
upper_survival_grid.strict_event: observed log10rho is strictly greater than the fixed grid threshold
upper_survival_grid.prediction: analytic V54 bounded-mixture survival probability at the threshold conditional on the unchanged seven fields
upper_survival_grid.weight_rule: cell weight j equals [M(edge_j)-M(edge_j-1)]/[M(upper_edge)-M(lower_edge)]; all 16 weights are finite, strictly positive, and sum to one within 1e-12
upper_survival_grid.score: sum over the 16 fixed positive cell weights of mean squared survival-probability error, divided by reference_probability*(1-reference_probability)
upper_survival_grid.maximum_threshold_truth_event: exactly zero because strict exceedance is used at the immutable global train maximum
upper_survival_grid.properness: every fixed-threshold Brier term is proper; their fixed positive weighted sum is proper, and addition to the unchanged strictly proper bounded NLL preserves strict propriety

likelihood_and_network.likelihood: unchanged V54 five-component Gaussian mixture in latent bounded-logit residual coordinates with exact Jacobian
likelihood_and_network.architecture: unchanged V54 seven-channel three-dimensional residual U-Net

training.mixed_precision: unchanged CUDA autocast plus GradScaler; bounded NLL and both analytic survival scores remain float32 or safer
training.augmentation: the same uniformly selected 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly to all seven conditions, physical backbone, and target
training.initialization: bitwise identical V50 and V54 seed-144044 initialization; no V54 checkpoint fine-tuning
training.validation: fixed diagnostic bounded NLL, V54 four-threshold score, upper-grid score, and composite at steps 4000, 8000, and 12000; never used for stopping, grid selection, checkpoint selection, or hyperparameter change

train_mechanism_gate.timing: after the fixed step-12000 checkpoint and before any V56 development sample
train_mechanism_gate.population: the identical V53/V54/V55 seed-146046 train-only 4096-voxel probe per object for 432 TNG100, 202 SIMBA, and 409 Swift objects
train_mechanism_gate.primary: 64-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature of the V56 bounded mixture in the domainwise q99.9-and-above query-backbone stratum
train_mechanism_gate.pass: V56 quadrature-over-truth mean delta squared is independently within [2/3,1.5] in TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift, with every aggregate 32-to-64 relative difference at most 0.005
train_mechanism_gate.comparison: also report sealed V50, V52, and V54 ratios without using relative improvement as a substitute for the absolute pass
train_mechanism_gate.failure_action: seal failure and do not create any V56 development sample

sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.candidate: same-voxel monotone bounded-mixture CDF inversion of the unchanged paired V31 donor conditional-rank field using actual V56 query-local parameters
sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.inverse: unchanged 28-step latent Gaussian-mixture inverse at rank epsilon 1e-7 followed by the exact frozen sigmoid support transform
sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.post_sample: undo immutable V45 standardization and apply one exact residual DC projection before adding the unchanged query backbone
sampling_if_train_mechanism_passes.control: periodically roll all 15 V56 latent parameter fields by (16,8,4) native voxels while retaining the query, backbone, and donor rank

development_evaluation_if_train_mechanis.primary_pass: candidate passes field, Q3, and Q4 independently in every domain
development_evaluation_if_train_mechanis.sealed_references: V50 full-risk and V52 no-risk decisions and artifact hashes only; neither is resampled
development_evaluation_if_train_mechanis.selection_role: only the V56 query-local candidate can be selected
development_evaluation_if_train_mechanis.independent_gate_action_on_pass: seal V56 and await explicit user approval before any EAGLE access

the train mechanism gate passes but the development primary_pass fails otherwise
